title: Settings in a file: --env-file
summary: Hand the settings in .env to a container in one go, then change one and find out why restarting isn't enough.

tasks.title: `from-file` runs `greet-lab`, with `NAME` and `COLOR` exactly as in `.env`
tasks.hint: `docker run -d --name from-file -p 3401:3000 --env-file .env greet-lab`. `docker exec from-file env` shows what it got.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:3401` shows the name and colour from `.env`
tasks.hint: The app listens on 3000 inside, so the door is `-p 3401:3000`.

tasks.title: `.env` now says `COLOR=lightgreen`, and the page is light green
tasks.hint: Change the line in `.env` and save. A container reads its settings only when it's made: `docker restart` keeps the old ones. `docker rm -f from-file` and run it again.
